perspective:
SEEKER’s available information:

- I am looking for a film of any genre with a woman in the lead; I want a good heroine.
- I heard the recommender ask if I had seen *The Blind Side* (2009) with Sandra Bullock.
- I have not seen *The Blind Side*.
- I asked if it is the one about her adopting a black kid; the recommender confirmed “Yeah” and said it’s really good.
- I heard the recommender ask about *The Help* (2011) with Emma Stone and Viola Davis.
- I said I’ll rent it tonight. I also said I did see *The Help* and that it made me cry and laugh throughout.
- The recommender said “Yes, definitely. Loved that one.”
- I heard the recommender say she really likes *Precious*, about a girl whose mother is mean to her.
- I tried to watch *Precious* but couldn’t; it was too sad for me. It brought back memories because I was overweight in my early 20s.
- The recommender said *Precious* was awful and that she had to deal with so much.
- I heard the recommender mention *Extremely Loud and Incredibly Close* (2011) as another good Sandra Bullock film.
- I asked if it is based on the novel of the same name.
- The recommender said she wasn’t sure, and said it’s about an autistic boy who loses his father on 9/11.
